lines: Teri nigaah se aisi sharaab pi maine
couplets.en: What wine I drank from your gaze.

lines: Ke phir na hosh ka daava kiya kabhi maine
couplets.en: I never claimed to be sober again.

lines: Woh aur honge jinhein maut aa gayi hogi
couplets.en: It must have been others whom death came for.

lines: Nigaah-e-yaar se paayi hai zindagi maine
couplets.en: I found life in the gaze of my beloved.

lines: Ae gham-e-zindagi, kuchh to de mashwara
couplets.en: O sorrow of my life, give me some counsel.

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Her house lies one way, the tavern the other.

lines: Main kahaan jaaun, hota nahin faisla
couplets.en: Where shall I go when I cannot decide?

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Her house lies one way, the tavern the other.

lines: Ek taraf baam par
couplets.en: On one side, up on the rooftop.

lines: Ek taraf baam par koi gulfaam hai
couplets.en: On one side, a rose-hued beauty stands on the roof.

lines: Ek taraf mehfil-e-baada-o-jaam hai
couplets.en: On the other, they gather over wine and cups.

lines: Dil ka dono se hai kuchh na kuchh vaasta
couplets.en: The heart has a tie to each.

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Her house lies one way, the tavern the other.

lines: Uske dar se utha to kidhar jaaunga
couplets.en: If I rise from her doorstep, where will I go?

lines: Maikada chhod doonga to mar jaaunga
couplets.en: If I leave the tavern, I will die.

couplets.en: I have one life, and two ask it of me.

lines: Dil bata, pehle kis ka karoon haq ada
